name: Language ID
description: Detects the language a short text is written in. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Identify the language each sentence is written in.

labels.name: spanish
labels.hint: dónde, gracias, está, quiero, por favor

labels.name: french
labels.hint: où, merci, je, est-ce, s'il vous plaît, bonjour

labels.name: german
labels.hint: ich, nicht, danke, wo ist, bitte, guten

labels.name: italian
labels.hint: grazie, dov'è, vorrei, buongiorno, per favore
